thread:
elaine: Heads-up — I'm opening a docs PR to add an "offline installer signing" section for Private installs. Need: verification examples, HSM/PKCS#11 guidance, cert rotation note, and an air-gapped mirror checklist. Can folks 👀 and add snippets?

sam: Quick clarifying q: are we documenting signing performed by customer HSM only, or our release pipeline signing too? different workflows.

mike: For Private/VPC customers the recommended flow is HSM-backed signing (customer side) + our release-signed bundles. Doc should call out both and show how to verify both signatures.

tara: I can take the PR review. Please add short runnable examples (cli + python) and an explicit preflight checklist for offline mirrors. Prefer examples under docs/private/offline/ rather than a long paragraph.

elaine: Draft snippet for verifying bundle signatures (CLI):
```bash
# verify vendor signature then our signature
gpg --keyring vendor.gpg --verify bundle.tar.gz.sig bundle.tar.gz
gpg --keyring redwood.gpg --verify bundle.tar.gz.redwood.sig bundle.tar.gz
```
Include note: import vendor/redwood public keys into a local keyring first.

sam: Adding a minimal python example to programmatically fetch and verify (for devs who script installs):
```python
import requests, subprocess, tempfile
url = 'https://mirror.example.com/bundle.tar.gz'
sig_url = url + '.redwood.sig'
resp = requests.get(url)
open('bundle.tar.gz','wb').write(resp.content)
open('bundle.tar.gz.redwood.sig','wb').write(requests.get(sig_url).content)
subprocess.check_call(['gpg','--keyring','redwood.gpg','--verify','bundle.tar.gz.redwood.sig','bundle.tar.gz'])
```
Note: show import step earlier.

mike: For HSM/PKCS#11 customers add this short command snippet for signing / verifying with pkcs11-tool (example):
```bash
# sign with HSM (pkcs11 uri depends on device)
pkcs11-tool --module /usr/lib/softhsm/libsofthsm2.so --sign --mechanism SHA256-RSA-PKCS --id 01 -i bundle.tar.gz -o bundle.sig
# verification still uses vendor public key / gpg wrapper that understands the public cert
```
Also add guidance: rotate signing certs every 90 days (customer configurable); include a rollback section.

deploy-bot: CI check failed for docs PR #4521 — broken link check: docs/private/offline/mirror-checklist.md -> 404

tara: on it — I'll correct the link and add a tiny smoke test in the PR (verifies that each codeblock has a language tag and that key filenames are consistent). I'll also add the mirror preflight: ports, allowed egress ranges, firewall checklist, checksum verification steps.

kevin: One more ask from platform: please add a short paragraph about bundle format version pinning. Upgrading bundles without pinning has caused nginx config mismatches in a past customer. Suggest example of versioned filename `bundle-v1.2.3.tar.gz` and a compatibility table.

elaine: Perfect. I'll update the PR with: CLI + python + pkcs11 examples, mirror checklist, cert-rotation recommendation, version-pinning note. Tagging @tara for review when pushed.

docs-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4521 — metadata added (labels: docs, private-installer, airgap)

tara: Received — I'll review tomorrow morning and add small edits for tone. If no major blockers I'll merge and follow-up with a changelog entry. :thumbsup:

elaine: Thanks all — assigning ownership: docs -> tara, engineering snippet validation -> sam, security review -> mike. Leave a comment in the PR if you change examples so I don't miss updates.
